source_caption:
🎬 Monsters vs. Aliens (2009)

Monsters vs. Aliens follows Susan Murphy, an ordinary young woman whose life takes an extraordinary turn when she is struck by a mysterious meteorite on her wedding day, causing her to grow into a giant nearly 50 feet tall. Suddenly captured by the military and renamed Ginormica, Susan is taken to a secret government facility where she meets a group of unusual monsters, including the brilliant but insect-headed Dr. Cockroach, the hilarious gelatinous B.O.B., the prehistoric Missing Link, and the enormous Insectosaurus. Although Susan initially struggles to accept her new identity, everything changes when a powerful alien named Gallaxhar launches an invasion of Earth. With humanity facing a dangerous threat, the government releases the monsters and gives them an opportunity to become unlikely heroes. Together, they must overcome their differences, discover their strengths, and save the planet from destruction. Featuring the voices of Reese Witherspoon, Seth Rogen, Hugh Laurie, Will Arnett, Kiefer Sutherland, and Rainn Wilson, the film delivers hilarious comedy, exciting action, unforgettable characters, and heartwarming lessons about friendship, courage, self-acceptance, and embracing what makes everyone unique.

🎭 Genre: Animation • Comedy • Science Fiction • Adventure • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 34m • PG

🎥 Directors: Rob Letterman & Conrad Vernon

✍️ Writers: Maya Forbes, Wallace Wolodarsky, Rob Letterman, Jonathan Aibel & Glenn Berger

🎬 Studio: DreamWorks Animation

📚 Story: An unlikely team of monsters must defend Earth against an alien invasion while discovering the importance of teamwork and accepting their differences.

🏆 Awards: Nominated for multiple Annie Awards, recognizing achievements in animation.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Monsters vs. Aliens is a 2009 American animated science fiction comedy film directed by Conrad Vernon and Rob Letterman and written by Letterman, Maya Forbes, Wally Wolodarsky, Jonathan Aibel and Glenn Berger. Produced by DreamWorks Animation, it is the first installment in the Monsters vs. Aliens franchise. The film stars Reese Witherspoon, Seth Rogen, Hugh Laurie, Will Arnett, Kiefer Sutherland, Rainn Wilson, Paul Rudd, and Stephen Colbert. The film involves a group of misfit monsters (Witherspoon, Rogen, Laurie, Arnett) tasked by the United States Armed Forces to stop the invasion of an extraterrestrial villain (Wilson) and save the Earth in exchange for freedom.
